lines.dialogue: What do you wanna do with him?
Yes, of course. We are heroes, and that’s what heroes do.
Though. He’ll probably just get released tomorrow.
Everyone recording everything on their phones -- it’s like you can’t even do your job.
What is the world coming to?

...pretty impressive, Tim. Any trouble sleeping? Depression? TIM (ON SCREEN) No, ma’am. MOTHER’S MILK Yo. That dude she’s with, he look familiar to you? STORMFRONT (O.S.) What about nausea? Headaches? TIM (O.S.) No.
That’s promising. I think we’re pretty damn close.
You were admitted to Sage Grove as suicidal, Tim. You still may be a danger to yourself.
Okay, okay. We’ll sort it out.
Been looking everywhere for you.
What happened to your trailer?
Sorry, it went long.
What’s wrong?
You sure?
You were -- checking on me?
Hold on. Just let me --
Lamplighter?? You here??
I just killed six subjects out there like a fucking Teddy Bear picnic. What the hell happened?
Where’s Dr. Carlton?
Clean up this mess. I’ll go see who else is loose.
I’ll never lie to you again. I’ll tell you everything.
Starting with this. HOMELANDER Your... grandmother.
My daughter.
Chloe. She died of Alzheimer’s a few years ago.
I was born in 1919. In Berlin.
Heinrich Himmler. He was a lovely dancer... there’s Goebbels... and here, the most important man in the room.

He gave me the first successful V injection. He taught me everything. Then we fell in love, he gave me a daughter. He made me -- his genius made you. STORMFRONT (CONT’D) Frederick didn’t care about fans or stardom or any of that shallow bullshit. We’re in a War for the Culture. The other races are grinding us down, stealing what’s rightfully ours. But we can fight back. With an army of super men, millions strong. That’s the true destiny of Vought. And you’re the one who will lead us. STORMFRONT (CONT’D) So yes, I love you, with all my heart. How could I not? Everyone I’ve ever loved is in the
I mean, we got Mr. Marathon -- We got him!
He’s right. Black Noir has the biggest ego, though.
But really, I can’t believe how chill everyone is. It feels like I’m back home, just making a movie with my friends.
Unresponsive. They don’t think there’s brain damage, but apparently, it’s hard to tell.
Yes. Because none of that matters now. Because of this --
I wish I killed Vogelbaum.
But no. It wasn’t me.
None that we know of.

Maybe. He is pretty smart -- especially for his kind. Hey. Smile. This is all good news. STORMFRONT (CONT’D) Yes, there’s been some sacrifices, but we are this close. To -- no more premieres. Or paparazzi.
Or screaming fans or any of that dancing monkey shit.
We gotta make sure the right people get the doses, of course... but it’s a whole new world. HOMELANDER And what about the wrong people? Couple billion of them, they won’t just sit there.
Don’t worry, silly. Frederick had a solution for everything.
What happened to your hair?
You know what? I’d feel lonely too, if I were cooped up by myself in this West Elm Death Star.
How about a field trip? What do you say, Dad? WAITER Welcome to Planet Vought. Would you like to try our new Brave Maeve Rainbow Veggie Burger? Holy shit!
Told you your Dad was a big deal. HOMELANDER Wait till you try the Big Homey with bacon. And the Mocha Noir Shake, it won’t be lumpy like your Mom’s.
Where’s Ryan?
So? Go in anyway.
You’re the strongest man in the world, and you’re scared of a little boy.
He’s your blood. Just talk to him. Be the man I see.
That’s really sweet, Ryan. But it’s also something we can’t afford. See, we’re under attack.
There’s bad guys who want to hurt people who look like us. Wipe us from the Earth, just because of the color of our skin.
They call it a ‘White Genocide.’ And we’re gonna need your help to protect our kind.
You gotta be fucking kidding me!
There you are. Slippery little bitch. I assume you sent all those lies to the press? ANNIE They’re not lies.

The pictures are obviously deepfakes and you’re a lying slut. Besides, people love what I have to say. Believe in it. They just don’t like the word ‘Nazi,’ that’s all. ANNIE What about the truth? STORMFRONT What truth? What’s the truth?
What’s so funny?
You yellow fucking bitch!
You’re not like her, Ryan. You belong with us.
Ryan. We love you.
YOU BITCH!!
Look at me. I like to see the light go out.
